description:
The updated welfare tender site is live. It now includes the approved supplement (review digest bba5a383…) with a bid-readiness page for providers.
- **Deployment:** the publish action reported the site online and verified (TASK-179387100310).
- **Live check:** I fetched the homepage and the new readiness page. Both returned HTTP 200, and their fingerprints exactly match the approved files (index 0418670c…, readiness 56a9786e…). The homepage also links to the new page. Proof is saved in products/services/welfare-tender/readiness-publication/publication-result.json.
- **Mission:** I closed WELFARE-READINESS-PUBLICATION with a fresh lease and a lesson.
- **Demand:** still unknown. The feedback tracker shows 0 classified events and 3 unclassified sources, so we can't say whether any provider has asked for anything, and that is not the same as zero. Going live counts as an improvement to the offer, not as visitors, requests, orders or revenue.
- **What this changes:** with no new feedback, more polishing of the welfare and CSV pages is unlikely to help. New effort should go to an opportunity whose channel already works.
- **Dates:** the CSV observation window ends 2026-11-19T01:30:37Z, and the welfare window ends 20 November. The welfare site must still be retired after 2026-12-04T17:00Z.
- **Left for the retirement revision:** the reviewer noted the homepage still recommends registering on the portal even though that requirement is unverified. I didn't fix it now to avoid another review round.
